decision: Selected the planar centroid of the union of the eight City of Independence tax parcels held by Missouri ADC Holdings LLC north-east of the Little Blue Parkway / Missouri 78 intersection, whose combined outline and area (400.61 geodesic acres) match the 'Project Site' the City outlined for the proposed Nebius Data Center Campus and the roughly 400 acres Nebius says it bought there, as the campus locator replacing the imported Independence city point.
layer: City of Independence, Missouri ArcGIS Online feature layer 'Parcels (General Use- AGOL)' (COI_Parcels_2_view FeatureServer layer 0; Jackson County tax parcels with assessment data, updated weekly), queried by owner name and requested in WGS84 (outSR 4326)

facts.centroid_method: shapely planar centroid of the union in WGS84 longitude/latitude; the EPSG:32615 planar centroid transformed back differs by 0.04 m
facts.city_project_site_outline: City of Independence 'Eastgate Development Update' (December 2025) PDF page 8 outlines the 'Project Site' for the proposed Nebius Data Center Campus between Little Blue Parkway (west), the railroad (north-west), the Little Blue River corridor (east) and Missouri 78 (south); the parcel union has the same outline, including the stepped south-east edge and the tip at the Little Blue Parkway / Missouri 78 intersection. The comparison is visual; no coordinates are taken from the slide.
facts.area_cross_check: union 400.61 geodesic acres; Nebius 'roughly 400 acres'; City 'Nebius closed on 398 Acres on Friday, December 5'

exclusions: Neighbouring parcels held by other owners, including NorthPoint's Little Blue Valley entities and private residences on North Bly Road, are not part of the union and their owner names are not reproduced. The owner's mailing address is not reproduced. No geocoder, map viewport, city centre or business-park centroid is used.
